newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Fairchild raised, stock jumps.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Fairchild raised, stock jumps.

text.p: Bankers Trust said it raised its rating of Fairchild Corp to a strong buy from buy on Monday and raised profit projections for the fiscal 1998 year ending in June.
-- Shares rose 1-3/4 to 19, a new 52-week high.
-- Analysts George Rubis and Wolfgang Demisch said in a research report "efforts to improve production scheduling, manufacturing efficiencies and negotiate firmer prices are finally bearing fruit."

-- Raised June fiscal 1998 EPS projection to $1.80 from $1.40, citing recovery at FA Fasteners business and strong customer acceptance of FA Technologies products. Estimates do not include any non-recurring contriubtions from asset dispositions.
-- Said at price of $17-1/4, stock is less then 10 times 1998 earnings estimates, giving it a 30 percent discount compared with peers.
